title: Dion3: Full-Stack Orthogonal Updates
abstract: arXiv:2608.11612v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The Muon optimizer incurs a significant overhead cost due to its cubic-time Newton-Schulz orthogonalization step. When weights are sharded, communication overhead compounds this computational cost, eroding the benefits of Muon in many settings. We present Dion3, a revision of Muon that targets this overhead at every level of the stack. Our Gram Newton-Schulz algorithm reduces the FLOP cost of orthogonalization, our CuteDSL kernels accelerate it by exploiting symmetry, and our megabatching strategy reduces communication overhead. Moreover, we propose a simple change to the update rule that cuts costs even further: selecting only a fraction of the momentum matrix's rows to orthogonalize at each step. This update rule improves on Dion (another "compressed" version of Muon), in both speed and performance. Overall, Dion3 matches or improves on the loss achieved by Muon but reduces optimizer step time by up to 6x. Dion3 is available via the

translated_abstract: Muon优化器因其三次时间复杂度的Newton-Schulz正交化步骤而承担了显著的额外开销。当权重被分片时，通信开销进一步加剧了这种计算成本，在许多场景下削弱了Muon的优势。我们提出了Dion3，这是对Muon的修订版本，旨在从堆栈的每一层解决这一开销。我们的Gram Newton-Schulz算法降低了正交化的浮点运算成本，我们的CuteDSL内核通过利用对称性加速了该过程，而我们的兆批量策略减少了通信开销。此外，我们提出对更新规则进行简单修改以进一步降低成本：每一步仅选择动量矩阵的一部分行进行正交化。这一更新规则在速度和性能上均优于Dion（Muon的另一种“压缩”版本）。总体而言，Dion3在损失上达到或优于Muon，但将优化器步骤时间减少了最多6倍。Dion3可通过以下方式获取。
tldr: Dion3通过全栈优化（包括Gram Newton-Schulz算法、对称性加速内核和兆批量策略）以及部分行正交化更新规则，在保持性能的同时将优化器步骤时间最多降低6倍。
en_tdlr: Dion3 achieves up to 6x faster optimizer step time while matching or improving loss performance through full-stack optimizations (Gram Newton-Schulz, symmetry-accelerated kernels, megabatching) and a partial row orthogonalization update rule.
